deck_direction.visual_strategy: Use evidence-led visuals on 6 of 10 slides; keep visuals subordinate to the slide claim.
deck_direction.density_strategy: Prefer low-to-medium density; shorten, change layout, or split before reducing typography below budget.
deck_direction.rhythm_strategy: Alternate text-led, visual-led, and transition silhouettes; do not repeat one layout family more than twice.
